resolved_implementation_constraints.issue: 423 clean TRAIN source additions exceed the 342 events in runtime-evaluable R5-0 words
resolved_implementation_constraints.resolution: Freeze the previously audited 16,582-word runtime population for scoring and require explicit reason accounting for every source event outside it; no mixed-error word is excluded merely because it is mixed.

resolved_implementation_constraints.issue: Multiple insertion boundaries may construct an identical target sequence inside repeated-phone runs
resolved_implementation_constraints.resolution: Freeze exact tie order lower boundary then lower phone index and require an equivalence/ambiguity diagnostic.

resolved_implementation_constraints.issue: zero_infinity=True can mask theoretically unalignable candidates
resolved_implementation_constraints.resolution: Require a pre-score minimum-CTC-step audit with zero unalignable candidates; otherwise stop before calibration.

resolved_implementation_constraints.issue: The threshold candidate set was not explicitly stated in the task
resolved_implementation_constraints.resolution: Freeze the established R4 exact float64 convention: both np.nextafter edges plus every unique finite calibration score. This adds determinism, not a tunable choice.
